Lemma
[Uniform gradient bounds for $\widetilde L_i$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0159, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0160, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0161 ↗ lem:chow-iv-shi-estimates-type-a ↗ lem:chow-iv-type-a-l-distance-upper-bound 1. ch30:30.7\group Singular-Time Reduced Distance

Under the hypotheses of Lemma 1, for every compact $K\subset \mathcal M_\infty $ and $\varepsilon \in (0,(\omega _\infty -\alpha _\infty )/2)$, there is a constant independent of $i$ such that \[ |\nabla \widetilde L_i|_{\Phi _i^*g_i}(q,t)\leq C \] on $K\times [\alpha _\infty +\varepsilon , \omega _\infty -\varepsilon ]$ for all sufficiently large $i$.
